summary: Tested the 4 new features (Backdate Sold Date, Delete Texted Photos, Recent Calls in dialer, Report a Bug + admin management) on both backend and frontend (mobile web 390x844). Backend: new pytest suite with 17 tests — all passing (recent-calls shape/limit, date-sold happy path + 400/404 validation + persistence via GET, bug-reports POST/GET/PATCH incl. filters, 403 for non-super-admin, 401 without X-User-ID, message_in photo hide + gallery filtering + invalid photo_type). Frontend: verified dialer Keypad/Recents toggle and Recents list (real calls with name, formatted phone, direction arrow, relative time, call button), name search + clear, SALE DATE field on /sold-quick (between purchase and referred-by, defaults to today, max=today, backdating works) and on /contact/sold-wizard step 2, /report-bug end-to-end submission -> 'Report Sent!' success screen with Done, /admin/bug-reports list + All/Open/In Progress/Resolved filters + Start Working -> Resolve -> Reopen transitions with live count updates, Hub (/more) entries 'Report a Bug' (Settings) and 'Bug Reports' (Internal Operations, super admin only, hidden for regular user). No Twilio calls/SMS were triggered; one real bug-report email was sent by the single UI submission. All TEST_QA data cleaned from db.bug_reports and contacts.hidden_gallery_urls.

minor.issue: No auth/ownership check — any caller can post a report on behalf of any user_id (and trigger a Resend email to all super admins). Unlike GET/PATCH there is no X-User-ID/token verification, so it is an unauthenticated email-trigger/spam vector.
Authorization relies solely on the X-User-ID header (no JWT verification), so any user id string that maps to a super_admin grants access. PATCH status has the same pattern.
user_id in the path is used only in the update filter and is not checked against the authenticated caller (BOLA surface consistent with the rest of contacts.py, flagging for awareness).

ui_bugs.issue: No route/role guard: a non-super-admin who navigates directly to /admin/bug-reports sees the full admin screen with the 'No bug reports' empty state. The 403 is only console.error'd — user gets no 'access denied' feedback and the empty state is misleading.
fetchReports catch only logs to console (no error state UI / retry), and setStatus swallows failures silently — if PATCH fails the row simply does not change with no toast.

Recent calls are not de-duplicated/grouped: 12 consecutive identical 'Bud (801) 821-2166 Mar 10' rows dominated the list (backend returns one row per call_placed event). Consider collapsing consecutive calls to the same contact with an (n) count like the native Phone app.
On web the SALE DATE renders as a raw HTML date input, so the spec'd '(Today)' suffix only appears on native. Minor spec/visual inconsistency (native TouchableOpacity path shows the suffix).

integration_issues.issue: The date-sold PATCH is wrapped in .catch(() => {}) in sold-quick.tsx (~line 175) and sold-wizard.tsx (~line 100), so a failed backdate is silently ignored and the sale is recorded with the default/today date without warning the rep.

issues: At 390px the filter row's last chip ('Resolved (1)') is clipped at the right edge; it is a horizontal ScrollView so it is reachable, but there is no visual affordance (no fade/indicator) that it scrolls.

data-testid attributes on React Native TouchableOpacity/TextInput are NOT emitted to the DOM on RN Web (verified: dialer-tab-recents, dialer-name-search-input, sold-date-input etc. all count=0), so automated web tests must fall back to text/placeholder selectors. Only the plain <input type=date> keeps its attribute. Consider testID + a web-only accessibilityLabel if DOM test ids are wanted.

action_items: Add a super-admin guard (or 'Access denied' UI) to /admin/bug-reports instead of rendering an empty list on 403.
Surface fetch/patch errors on the admin bug reports screen (error banner + retry, toast on failed status change).
Authenticate POST /api/bug-reports/{user_id} (verify caller == user_id) to stop unauthenticated report/email injection.
Do not swallow the date-sold PATCH failure in sold-quick.tsx / sold-wizard.tsx — surface a warning if the backdate did not save.
Optional: collapse consecutive duplicate calls in the dialer Recents list.
critical_code_review_comments: bug_reports.py: _require_super_admin trusts the raw X-User-ID header; all other new endpoints in this router should use the same JWT dependency the rest of the app uses.
bug_reports.py: submit_bug_report has no rate limiting and always calls _email_super_admins — combined with the missing auth this can be abused to spam super admins via Resend.
admin/bug-reports.tsx: empty catch blocks (lines ~55-60, ~65-70) hide API failures from the user; add error state + toast.
contact_events.get_recent_calls over-fetches limit*3 events and filters in Python; duplicates are returned per event so the UI shows long runs of the same contact.

success_rate.frontend: ~93% (all 4 features functional; 2 non-blocking defects: missing role guard + silent error handling on admin screen)

rca_of_the_issue: Non-admin access to /admin/bug-reports: the screen has no role check; fetchReports() catches the 403 and leaves reports=[] so the generic 'No bug reports' empty state renders. Data is not leaked (backend returns 403) but the UX implies the feature is empty rather than restricted.
